empty sentry.validate: entry of decide sentry #1 has neither an on-part nor an if-part.

if invalid operator.validate: entry of decide sentry #1 has an if-part that is not a valid expression.

on blank event.validate: entry of decide sentry #1 has an on-part without an event.

on item blank item.validate: entry of decide sentry #1 names plan-item event 'case.item.completed' without naming the item.

on item done second position no id.validate: entry of decide sentry #1 must be an object with an on-part and/or an if-part.

on item without item.validate: entry of decide sentry #1 names plan-item event 'case.item.completed' without naming the item.

on missing event.validate: entry of decide sentry #1 has an on-part without an event.

on null.validate: entry of decide sentry #1 has an on-part without an event.

on scalar.validate: entry of decide sentry #1 has an on-part without an event.

on unknown event.validate: entry of decide sentry #1 names event 'nope.happened', which is not in the event catalog.

other keys only.validate: entry of decide sentry #1 has neither an on-part nor an if-part.

scalar.validate: entry of decide criteria must be a list of sentries.

scalar sentry.validate: entry of decide sentry #1 must be an object with an on-part and/or an if-part.
